title: Boundary estimate |∂T₁(fω)| ≤ (m+1)∫_{M₁}(|f||Dω| + |Df||ω|) dH^{m+1} for an integral current with unit-bounded orientation
statement:
Setting: P, m ∈ ℕ; U, M₁ ⊆ ℝ^P arbitrary sets; T₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U); ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{m+1}. Assume:
(h2) T₁(θ) = ∫_{M₁} ξ(x)(θ(x)) dH^{m+1}(x) for every θ ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(U), for μHE[m+1] restricted to M₁.
(h3) For μHE[m+1]⌞M₁-a.e. x, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ ‖α‖ for every (m+1)-covector α, where ‖α‖ is the operator norm.
Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be differentiable, and let ω, F ∈ 𝒟^m(U) satisfy F(x) = f(x)·ω(x) for all x. Then, in [0, ∞],
ofReal |∂T₁(F)| ≤ ∫⁻_{M₁} ofReal((m+1)·(|f(x)|·‖Dω(x)‖ + ‖Df(x)‖·‖ω(x)‖)) dH^{m+1}(x),
with operator norms of Fréchet derivatives.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M₁ : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (m + 1)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T₁ ω = ∫ x in M₁, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m + 1].restrict M₁), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ ‖α‖) → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (ω F : TestFormOn U m), Differentiable ℝ f → (∀ x, (F : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x = f x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) → ENNReal.ofReal |T₁.boundary F| ≤ ∫⁻ x in M₁, ENNReal.ofReal (((m : ℝ) + 1) * (|f x| * ‖fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ * ‖(ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x‖)) ∂μHE[m + 1]
